title: Sign-in methods and session policy
question: Which sign-in methods does Track3D support for which customers? What are the password rules, and how long do web and mobile sessions last, both idle and in total?
context: Code offers several providers and defaults to 15-minute web and 24-hour mobile access tokens inside a fixed session end (USER-REQ-007, USER-REQ-009, USER-REQ-010). These are source defaults, not an agreed policy.
